titles.native: アルプス物語 わたしのアンネット

description:
Annette was born into a poor family in Switzerland.

She is a sweet girl and takes good care of her little brother Dannie. Lucien is her best friend.

One day, Lucien angrily slaps Dannie's Ermine, which develops into a limp.

The happy days turn into a long period of suffering, but little by little Annette and Lucien regain their lost friendship.
